decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a design-led variant of the core drainage business and still fits current bathroom architecture trends, so it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
The shower channel for seamless coverings is close to the firm's core offer, supports modern premium bathroom designs, and its dedicated presentation indicates ongoing commercial commitment.

The pump-assisted shower drainage line serves a more specialized installation need and faces some portfolio rationalization risk, but it still supports the firm's barrier-free and technically demanding applications strategy.

As a newly launched pump-drain shower channel with its own product page, it appears to be an actively backed extension of the firm's innovation focus and is therefore more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
